skills.name: Stellar Marking
skills.description:
Activates Stellar Marking to record skills on the Stellagram and fuse Constellations based on the recorded skill combinations.
Constellation fusion is based on the type and number of Marking Skills recorded, and is not affected by the order of the recorded skills.

skills.name: Return to Oort
skills.description: Returns you to Oort, birthplace of the stars.

skills.name: Starry Wave
skills.description:
Allows you to descend slowly by gliding upon starlight when you hold the jump key.
Gliding Command Lock: Right-click

skills.name: Stellar Reset
skills.description: Exerts the power of the stars to erase the progress recorded in the Stellagram.

skills.name: Astral Magic Guard
skills.description: Grants the blessing of the stars to both decrease damage taken and transfer some damage received. Does not apply to attacks that do a certain percentage of your Max HP. Also permanently increases Defense.

skills.name: Astral Movement
skills.description: Accelerates the speed at you can call upon the stars to permanently increase Speed, Max Speed, and Jump.

skills.name: Ray
skills.description:
[Marking Skill] Fires a lance of starlight in front of you and records Ray on the Stellagram.
Using Ray and the down key simultaneously resets the Stellagram record.

skills.name: Stellar I - Antares
skills.description:
[Constellation Skill] Complete the Antares fusion to summon one of Antares's rabbit holes.
Rabbit holes periodically pull in nearby enemies and deal continuous damage.
Up to 4 rabbit holes can be maintained and rabbit holes are unaffected by attack reflection.
[Stellagram Fusion] Ray - Ray - Ray - Ray
Stellagram Fusion Lock: Right-click
